treatments.name: Anti-wrinkle
treatments.longDesc: Softens forehead lines, frown lines and crow's feet. Subtle enough that people just think you look well-rested.

treatments.name: Lip filler
treatments.longDesc: Shape, symmetry and hydration — from a barely-there boost to a fuller finish, always proportional to your face.

treatments.name: Jaw & chin contouring
treatments.shortDesc: Definition along the jawline and chin.
treatments.longDesc: Dermal filler along the jawline and chin to sharpen and balance the lower face — the profile change shown above.

treatments.name: Dermaplaning
treatments.longDesc: A blade gently lifts dead skin and peach fuzz. Instantly smoother makeup application and brighter skin.

treatments.name: Skin boosters
treatments.longDesc: Micro-injections of hydrating actives for skin that looks better on its own, not just under filter.

treatments.name: Lip flip
treatments.shortDesc: Subtle upper lip roll, no filler.
treatments.longDesc: A small amount of anti-wrinkle treatment relaxes the top lip so it rolls out slightly for more visible pink.
